desktop.title: Codex Desktop conversation
desktop.hint: Send /bind with the conversation link in Feishu, then chat normally. Models, login and permissions remain in Desktop.
desktop.blocked: Blocked; check Desktop or delivery permissions

feishu.title: Create a Feishu app by QR code
feishu.hint: Scan with Feishu and confirm app creation on the official page. Credentials are saved only in the local backend.
feishu.scan: Open Feishu on your phone and scan this code, or open the official page below.
feishu.next: App created. Pair a test chat, then bind a Desktop conversation.

status.checking: App created; checking credentials and bot…
status.pairing: Waiting for the creator to send the code in a private bot chat

errors.network: Could not connect to Feishu. Check your network and retry.
errors.invalid-response: Feishu returned an invalid response. Please retry.
errors.registration-failed: App creation was not completed. Check the official page.
errors.unsupported-brand: Please use Feishu; Lark is not supported by this setup.
errors.credentials-not-ready: The app was created but credentials are not ready. Retry the check.
errors.bot-not-ready: The app was created but the bot is not ready. Enable or publish it in Feishu, then retry.
errors.save-failed: Could not save the local setup record. Check local storage before retrying.
errors.interrupted: Setup was interrupted. Continue with the existing app or QR code.
errors.pairing-expired: Pairing code expired. Check the app again, then retry pairing.
errors.pairing-failed: Pairing failed. Check your network and Feishu event subscription, then retry.

feishu.pairHint: Open a private chat with the new bot and send the code below. Only the app creator can pair; the code is never sent to Codex.
feishu.pairedNext: Test chat saved. Manage the Desktop conversation binding below.
